announcements.title: Annual Cebu Open Pickleball Championship 2026
announcements.short_desc: Registration is officially open for the CasaVista Masters. Featuring Men's, Women's, and Mixed Open brackets with standard tournament rules and cash awards.
announcements.full_desc:
We are honored to host the 2026 CasaVista Masters Tournament across all 3 certified hardcourts this August.

Tournament Schedule & Details:
• Aug 21-22: Mixed Doubles Prelims & Quarter-finals
• Aug 23: Championship Finals & Sunset Awards Reception

Complimentary tournament jerseys, hydration stations, and access to the recovery cold plunge pool are included for all registered players. Inquire through front desk or submit your doubles roster today.
announcements.author: Sports & Recreation Director

announcements.title: Main Infinity Pool & Coastal Deck Filtration Upgrade
announcements.short_desc: Scheduled eco-filtration maintenance will take place on Tuesday morning from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM to maintain pristine seawater clarity.
announcements.full_desc:
To uphold our rigorous environmental sanitation standards, our coastal infinity pool filtration undergoes preventative maintenance every Tuesday morning.

What to expect:
• Private villa plunge pools and cabanas remain 100% operational.
• The resort beachfront lounge and sports courts will be open during regular operational hours.
• Refreshment bar will serve complimentary iced tea for affected guests at the garden deck.
announcements.author: Resort Operations Office

announcements.title: Seaside Acoustic Dinners & Farm-To-Table Grill
announcements.short_desc: Join our culinary team every Friday and Saturday evening for fresh Mactan seafood skewers, organic farm produce, and live acoustic lounge music.
announcements.full_desc:
Spend sunset beneath the palms at our beachfront terrace with an exclusive culinary showcase by Chef Marco Rivera.

Features:
• Catch-of-the-day yellowfin tuna and tiger prawns grilled over coconut husk embers
• Organic greens harvested directly from Central Visayas partner farms
• Live bossa nova and acoustic sets from 6:00 PM to 9:30 PM
announcements.author: Executive Chef
